title: Mean squared error reduction of (plug-in) look-ahead estimators for Markov chains
summary: We consider the estimation of the invariant distribution $π$ of a Markov kernel on a discrete state space (or of the mean value $π(f)$ of a functional $f$ under $π$) when solving the invariance equation is not feasible. Look-ahead estimators exploit the knowledge of the kernel by propagating the empirical occupation measure through $k$ steps of the chain. When the kernel is known, as in Markov chain Monte Carlo, we compare their mean squared error with that of the empirical estimator, for independent or Markovian data, stationary or not.
